result.summary: No critical breakage found. Page is functional but shows minor visual inconsistencies: truncated restaurant name at scroll edge, low-quality / placeholder-style thumbnails in 'Fastest near you', and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' has restaurant name cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the right screen edge without ellipsis or padding
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal list end-padding and use ellipsis truncation so names do not clip mid-character

issues.description: 'Fastest near you' thumbnails show small centered illustrations with large empty solid backgrounds and look low-resolution / pixelated compared to full-bleed photos in 'Popular right now' section
issues.suggestion: Use consistent full-bleed high-resolution restaurant images for all cards instead of small placeholder-style illustrations

issues.description: Favorite heart icon treatment is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': first card shows white outline with no background, second card shows white outline on a dark circular scrim
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent button style with a semi-transparent dark circular background to all wishlist icons for contrast and visual consistency
